parameters.content:
# START HERE: XT Trip Discount Codes (#355)

- **When:** daily 10:00 SGT (workflow timezone Asia/Singapore), or by hand with Manual Run.
- **Input:** the Google Sheet `XT discount codes - intake` (tab and columns: `SHEET_LAYOUT` in **Run Settings**, the only place columns are named). The X-Trekkers consultant adds one row per traveller and ticks Ready. Rows not ticked, and rows already DONE, ADOPTED or EXPIRED_NO_ACCOUNT, are skipped.
- **Flow:** settings -> read the sheet -> one Shopify sign-in -> check each row -> look up each good row in Shopify (the customer with exactly this email, and the code) -> decide -> make or adopt codes -> write the result back into the row's automation columns.
- **Never creates, edits or tags a Shopify customer** (owner, 24 Nov 2026). A code is made only for an existing customer whose email matches exactly; otherwise the row says why (NEEDS_SHOPIFY_ACCOUNT and the other statuses in the sheet's How to use tab).
- **Codes:** `XT-INV<booking no. digits>` (one per row; `-<NN>` only if the layout gets a traveller column), 15% off, locked to that one customer, 3 uses, combines with nothing, ends 23:59 SGT on max(deposit + 12 months, departure) (`VALIDITY_RULE` later). An existing code for the same customer (the code column is only a hint; Shopify is asked) is adopted: one update to 3 uses, that end date and no combining; more than 3 uses so far, not 15%, or another customer -> CONFLICT, nothing changes.
- **Brakes:** more than 300 lookups or more than 30 code writes in one run -> none of them, rows HELD, one error alert.
- **Errors only:** row problems stay in the sheet for the consultant. Run problems send one plain-English ERROR through **XB Ops Alert Email** (system `XT-CODES`), counted by the daily health check; the run then ends as failed.
- **Dry run:** `DRY_RUN` is on in this export. A dry run reads the sheet and Shopify but writes nothing anywhere and sends nothing; its plan is the output of **Decide Code Writes** (or **Check Intake Rows** when nothing needs a lookup), read in the open editor.
- **No saved executions** (the access token and travellers' emails are in item data). Runbook: `docs/xt_trip_discount_codes.md`.

# Setup (local import copy only)

- Import inactive. **XB Ops Alert Email** must already accept system `XT-CODES` (re-imported first).
- Credentials (owner steps, runbook O2 and O4): the Shopify app on **Get Shopify Access Token** only; the Google Sheets account on **Read Intake Sheet**, **Re-read Row Keys** and **Write Back To Sheet** only. No other node has a credential.
- The first real run and activation each need their own owner OK.

## Required manual configuration:

- **Run Settings**
  - `SHOP_DOMAIN`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_SHOPIFY_SHOP_DOMAIN` with the store's myshopify domain (local import copy only).
  - `SHEET_ID`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_XT_INTAKE_SHEET_ID` with the intake sheet's ID (local import copy only).
  - `DRY_RUN`: leave `true` until the owner OKs a real run; `false` at the capped first run and activation.
  - `SHEET_LAYOUT`: the tab name and, for each role, the header name in row 1 (runbook). Change it only with a reviewed PR when the sheet's headers change.
- **Send XT Alert**
  - `Workflow`: replace `REPLACE_WITH_OPS_ALERT_EMAIL_WORKFLOW_ID` with the live XB Ops Alert Email workflow id.

# Read and check

- Sheet tab from `SHEET_LAYOUT`, columns A:ZZ, raw values (dates as serial numbers), retried up to 3 times. Columns are found by their header names.
- One Shopify token per run (client credentials grant), retried up to 3 times.
- A header the layout names missing or doubled, an unreadable sheet or a failed sign-in stops the run: nothing written, one error alert.
- Row checks (CHECK_ROW, NEEDS_EMAIL, CHECK_EMAIL) need no Shopify call.

# Look up and decide

- One read per row, 1 every 500 ms: `customerByIdentifier` (exact email) and `codeDiscountNodeByCode` (new name, and old name for traveller 1). Reads are retried.
- Decide: NEEDS_SHOPIFY_ACCOUNT, CHECK_EMAIL, CONFLICT, EXPIRED_NO_ACCOUNT, ERROR, ADOPTED (no write needed), or a create / adopt write.
- Brake: more than 30 writes -> none, rows HELD.

# Write

- Code writes, 1 every 500 ms, never retried by n8n (a repeat create would fail as taken). Any HTTP error, GraphQL error, userErrors, or an answer without 3 uses and the planned end date is ERROR on the row; the next run finds a code that was made after all and adopts it.
- Sheet write-back: the sheet is read again first and the columns found again by header; a row whose invoice, traveller no. or email moved is not written this run. Only the automation's columns (code, end date, status, message, customer ID, checked, made), cell by cell, as plain text.
- Any problem -> **Build Error Alert** -> one email -> **End Run As Failed**.

assignments.name: SHEET_LAYOUT
assignments.value:
={{ ({
  tab: 'Travellers',
  last_row: 1000,
  invoice_pattern: '^INV-([0-9]{1,12})$',
  columns: {
    ready: 'Ready',
    invoice: 'Booking no. (invoice)',
    traveller: '',
    email: 'Email',
    trip: 'Trip code',
    deposit: 'Deposit date',
    departure: 'Departure date',
    code: 'Discount code',
    status: 'Code status',
    made: 'Code created in Shopify',
    ends: 'Shopify end date',
    message: 'Message',
    customer: 'Shopify customer ID',
    checked: ''
  }
}) }}

assignments.name: alert
assignments.value: ={{ ({ severity: 'ERROR', key: 'unexpected_error', short: 'unexpected_error', lines: [($('Write Codes').isExecuted === false ? 'XT trip discount codes: the run today stopped on an unexpected error before it made or changed any code. Ask Claude to check.' : 'XT trip discount codes: the run today stopped on an unexpected error. Some codes may already have been made or updated; the sheet may not show them yet. Ask Claude to check.'), 'Detail for Claude: a Code node failed; executions are not saved, so run it by hand with DRY_RUN on and read the plan.'] }) }}
